text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian brilliantly succeeded in 
leaving her mark on the Twinkle Series.

Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years."
And today, she once again—
(WAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer, what's our next race?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then that is fine. I shall look 
forward to what lies ahead.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Brian, great run today as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help shouting out loud myself. 
But in the next race...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Maya's gonna take down Brian-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
No way, you're taking me on one-on-one! 
And I'm gonna win!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey! That's one heck of a lineup! Get 
the camera, hurry, hurry!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! Who are you racing against 
next!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Calling it a nuisance feels like a 
luxury problem.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Well, fine. I don't care who it is, I'll 
take on anyone."
Well then...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Do I have the right to compete with you as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Symboli Rudolf-san!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"What do you say, Brian? Will you accept 
this proposal?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Do you mind, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
...!! Hurry, call the editorial 
department! Narita Brian just dropped 
another fascinating quote!

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Brian-san! Please tell us about your 
future goals!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

—Today, once again, she stands at the 
center of the excitement.
